speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To begin my assessment, could you please describe the specific appearance and location of the skin lesion(s) you are concerned about?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the non-healing nature of these lesions and your significant smoking history, do you have a history of genital warts or any known exposure to the human papillomavirus (HPV)? Additionally, are you currently immunocompromised or diagnosed with HIV?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Non-healing, crusty, red lesions on the penile shaft and left middle finger. I also have Lesions are painless, History of unsuccessful treatment for syphilis and eczema.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any swollen lymph nodes in your groin or armpit, and do the lesions bleed easily when touched? I would also like to examine the lesions directly to assess their borders and texture.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No known malignancies or hereditary diseases in the family. Previous treatments for syphilis and eczema. Social history: Lives with his 4th wife, smokes 2 packs of cigarettes per day for the last 30 years, has recently immigrated from Africa.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: Biopsy_of_penile_and_digital_lesions. I need histopathological confirmation to rule out Squamous Cell Carcinoma or extragenital Bowen's disease, especially given the risk factors for HPV-related malignancies.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Biopsy findings show cells with nuclear hyperchromasia, multinucleation, and increased mitotic figures within the follicle-bearing epithelium.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy results confirm Squamous Cell Carcinoma in situ, also known as Bowen's disease. I am ordering a full skin examination and HPV testing to check for other affected sites. DIAGNOSIS READY: Bowen's disease (Squamous Cell Carcinoma in situ)
